gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, its bowls filling out each line of sans text. Galaxy sits above it as a cosmic display heading, drawn in a marker-like constant line.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-numans: Glass tubing bent into letters, that is Galaxy, a heading with a dense, tall lowercase and loose, spacious fit. Numans sits below as a modern sans, its s ends hanging far from the spine while Galaxy handles the commanding part.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-onest: Approachable is the first thing Onest says, with short ascenders above big bowls and a gentle monotone line in its sans-serif text. Onest keeps a long page easygoing, while Galaxy overhead stays cosmic, loosely spaced and commanding.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-open-sans: Galaxy draws its heading with stroke edges running parallel through every curve, cosmic and loosely spaced. Open Sans takes over below as a plain sans with bulky lowercase proportions, giving the text a smooth read where no curve clogs.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-orienta: Neutral and modern, Orienta lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Galaxy above feels drawn with ruler and compass, cosmic and commanding, so a long page of Orienta reads gently by comparison, its cases close in height.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-oxygen: Stencil-cut letters of one steady width, that is Galaxy, cosmic and commanding with plenty of breathing space. Oxygen follows as a plain sans whose curves never close back on themselves, and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals keeps long text clean.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-parkinsans: Galaxy holds one uninterrupted line width on every letter, with a dense, tall lowercase band and loose fit. And Parkinsans, a contemporary sans-serif with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, carries longer text without any fuss.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-pathway-extreme: Modern and clean, Pathway Extreme keeps clear openings in its rounded letters, with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height. And Galaxy above, with strokes like thread stitched along a path, gives its sans text a cosmic head start.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-preahvihear: Galaxy has hairline-free, swell-free letterforms and a cosmic pull. Preahvihear, a sans with an open mouth like a pried oyster shell and a lofty x-height, gives the pair its strongest quality: a commanding top paired with an open, contemporary text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-prompt: Prompt is an approachable plain sans, oversized in its small letters. Galaxy heads it with a cosmic, commanding voice, its t having crossbar and stem of matching weight, and the pair's strongest quality is how openly Prompt's apertures read beneath it.
